name: Abstemiousness
overview: Scripture emphasizes the virtue of abstemiousness as self-control in appetite and conduct, warning against indulgence that leads to spiritual harm, as seen in Proverbs where one is urged to exercise restraint even when dining with a ruler. Daniel exemplifies this principle by deliberately refusing the king's rich food and wine to avoid defilement, demonstrating a heart committed to holiness. In contrast, Jesus faced accusations of gluttony and drunkenness, yet His wisdom and purpose were vindicated, highlighting that true abstemiousness is not mere external appearance but a matter of the heart aligned with God's wisdom.
